race.description: K J's Club Caf Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: JENNI MOO MOO (11) was scratched from an 1100m here yesterday to be kept for this. Chased a tearaway leader at Nowra last start over 1100m and kept to the task to finish second. Has had plenty of chances but this is not strong so today might be her day. IZZY A WARRIOR (5) from the Danny Williams barn looks the pick of the first starters following a trial win at Goulburn last weekend. Modestly bred but looks to have ability. YES RED (8) has not raced since finishing third on a heavy track over this course and distance on debut 20 weeks ago. Betting watch advised. BORATA'S GIRL (10) has drawn wide but still appears the next in line in her return.
